items.exampleEn: She is a senior manager at a bank.
items.exampleZh: 她是一家銀行的資深經理。

items.exampleEn: A crowd of people was waiting for the bus.
He wants to marry her next year.
Our company has a female boss.
items.exampleZh: 我們公司的老闆是女性。

items.exampleEn: In his youth, my father loved to play basketball.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸年輕的時候很愛打籃球。

items.exampleEn: In our office, only two workers are male.
items.exampleZh: 在我們辦公室裡，只有兩位員工是男性。

items.exampleEn: I invited ten friends to my party.
items.exampleZh: 我邀請了十個朋友來我的派對。

items.exampleEn: My sister has been married for five years.
items.exampleZh: 我的姊妹已經結婚五年了。

items.audioEn: Thanks for inviting me, but I have to work on Saturday.
items.audioZh: 謝謝你邀請我，但我星期六得上班。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼不能去？

items.sentenceEn: He asked her to marry him.

items.stemEn: Thank you for ____ me. I'd love to come to your wedding.
items.stemZh: 謝謝你邀請我，我很樂意參加你的婚禮。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my cousin Jenny married her boyfriend, David. They invited two hundred guests, so there was a big crowd at the hotel. Jenny's grandmother gave a short speech about her own youth. "I got married when I was only nineteen," she said. "Be kind to each other, and you will be happy."
items.passageZh: 上週六，我的表親 Jenny 和她的男朋友 David 結婚了。他們邀請了兩百位客人，所以飯店裡擠滿了人。Jenny 的奶奶上台簡短談了談她自己年輕時的事。她說：「我十九歲就結婚了。要好好對待彼此，你們就會幸福。」

options: 他們邀請了兩百位客人
飯店的宴會廳實在太小了

items.promptZh: 我爸爸是一家公司的資深工程師。
referenceEn: My father is a senior engineer at a company.
My dad is a senior engineer for a company.
rubricZh: senior 放在職稱前，表示「資深的」（例如 a senior engineer）
「在一家公司」可寫例如 at a company、for a company

items.promptZh: 那位女歌手的聲音很好聽。
referenceEn: That female singer has a beautiful voice.
The female singer has a lovely voice.
rubricZh: 用 female 表示「女性的」，放在名詞前（例如 female singer）
「聲音很好聽」可寫，例如 has a beautiful voice、her voice is very nice 等
